Name: Ritzy Cursor Recolors
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
[size=3]Good timezone everyone. I have made a cursor recolor mod instead of updating old mods.[/size] [size=1]I think I'm losing it.[/size]
[size=3]
I can take requests for more recolors, please just be patient with me, I am having trouble doing everything, even the things I used to love. if you want to request a recolor, please provide either a HEX code of the colors you want, or a .png of the colors you want me to use.
[/size]
[size=3]Cursor config currently includes:[/size]
Blue, Trans, Yellow, Pink, BlackAndWhite, and None. (None is the default cursor, in case you want to turn my recolor off.)


[size=5]REQUIREMENTS:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]


Download instructions:
[/size][size=4]Move the .zip file into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder, then extract the files.[/size][size=5]
[/size][size=4]When updating the mod (when a new version comes out) please DELETE the old folder! Do NOT merge the folders.[/size][size=5]

[size=3]If this mod is uploaded anywhere other than nexus, It has been stolen.

[/size][/size][size=4]I do NOT give permission for my mod to be used to train AI, or for any AI-related purposes![/size]


I may make a i18n for this in the future, probably when/if it i make more recolor options.
You may translate my mod (when the i18n comes out) as long as you do not use AI.

Downloads.Description: Added Black and White option, requested by a friend :)
